film.label: AIAZ FILM FESTIVAL
film.title: Reimagine Storytelling with Artificial Intelligence!
film.description: AIAZ is an international short film festival bringing together traditional cinema and artificial intelligence. AI-generated and traditionally produced films are evaluated through two distinct jury systems, creating a unique dialogue between human perspective and machine intelligence.
film.award1: AI-Generated Films — evaluated by a professional Human Jury.
film.award2: Traditionally Produced Films — evaluated by AIAZ, the festival’s Artificial Intelligence Jury.
film.award3: National & International Competitions — featuring distinct categories and signature AIAZ awards.

about.label: ABOUT AIAZ
about.title: About Us
intro: The AIAZ International Short Film Festival is the first festival in the Caucasus dedicated to the intersection of artificial intelligence and cinema. Founded in 2025 and held in Baku, it is a unique platform that brings technology and creativity together.
AIAZ is both Artificial Intelligence Azerbaijan and the name of the festival's AI-based jury system. It expresses the symbiosis of human creativity and machine thinking.
about.directionsIntro: The festival is held in two main directions:

directions.title: Films created with artificial intelligence
directions.description: are evaluated by a human jury made up of film critics, directors and art experts.

directions.title: Traditional, human-made films
directions.description: are evaluated by the AIAZ artificial intelligence, which is specially trained and has deep knowledge of Azerbaijani cinema.

about.quote: 🎥 AIAZ is more than a festival — it is a living dialogue between art and technology. Shaped by creativity, experimentation and the aesthetic taste of artificial intelligence, the festival shapes the film outlook of a new era.
events: Live interviews and presentations conducted with artificial intelligence
about.eventsNote: Both online and offline events will be held.
about.speech: 🎤 The festival's opening speech is delivered by AIAZ, and the artificial intelligence enters into a live dialogue with film scholars.
about.closing: AIAZ – the film festival of the future starts today. Human, machine and story together.

festivalRules.title: Competition Rules.
festivalRules.description: Before participating in the festival, please review the submission requirements and participation conditions.

rule1.title: Film Requirements
items: Submitted films must have been produced within the last two years.
Films must be no shorter than 1 minute and no longer than 30 minutes.
Films must be submitted with English subtitles in .srt format.

rule2.title: Submission Materials
items: A trailer and poster must be provided for each film.
The director's full name, short biography, and photo must be included.
Submitted materials may be used for festival promotion and presentation purposes.

rule3.title: AI Films
items: The artificial intelligence tools used during production must be disclosed.
A detailed list of the platforms and models used must be provided.
A director may submit only one film in AI and traditional categories.

rule4.title: Agreement
rule4.description: Any person submitting a film to the festival is considered to have agreed to all of the conditions stated above.
